justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/NexusAccessor.java` (especially lines 269-327). `Available` is a small nested dispatcher with only 2 fields (`register`, `clean`) and 3 methods (`isAlive`, `clean`, `register`), each delegating directly to reflective `Method.invoke` calls. The surrounding class already separates concerns into `InitializationAppender`, `Dispatcher.CreationAction`, `Available`, and `Unavailable`, so there is no evidence of excessive size, many responsibilities, or low cohesion in `Available`.
